problems.problem: The record says every figure was re-derived by a second reader that shares no code with the first. That holds only for the gate AUCs, re-derived by verify_faithful/myread.py, which imports neither readlib nor census. The dose verifier (verify_dose/vcore.py) imports readlib, trial_read and backend.census and builds the reading from readlib's own parts. The licence verifier (verify_license/verify.py) uses readlib's statistics. The first reviewers used the same readlib: dose/common.py imports readlib and trial_read. So the ±1/±2, loop, label, per-neuron and L57-range figures in the bullets were not checked by code independent of the reader or of the first reviewer.
